title: Iron Reflexes
text:
Iron Reflexes is a keystone passive skill that removes all evasion rating and converts it to armour.
Iron Reflexes essentially converts all sources of flat Evasion Rating to flat Armour, which is then multiplied by your "increased Armour" value as well as any "more Armour" modifiers. "Increased Evasion" and "More Evasion" become effectively useless.


== Mechanics ==
The final Armour value is calculated with the following formula:

  (Flat AR  + Flat EV) * (1 + [total #% increased/reduced AR]) * (More/Less AR modifiers)

where:

AR = Armour
Flat EV = Sum of Evasion Rating from Equipped Items (e.g. Body Armour, Shield) and other sources of additional (flat) Evasion Rating
Flat AR = Sum of Armour from Equipped Items (e.g. Body Armour, Shield) and other sources of additional (flat) Armour
More/Less modifiers from different sources are multiplicative with each other.


== Location ==
Iron Reflexes is located on the bottom side of the passive skill tree.


== Related unique items ==
These unique items have the Iron Reflexes modifier, which grants the effect of this keystone. This effect does not double up by also having the keystone allocated.
